title: Inside or Outside
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n. Then n vertices. Then q queries: each a
point. Print IN or OUT per query.

**Constraints:** 3 ≤ n ≤ 200000 (given per test); |x|, |y| ≤ 10^9.

Integer crossing test; the double-division W misclassifies.

tests.name: concave polygon
tests.code:
std::istringstream in("5
0 0
6 0
6 6
3 3
0 6
4
3 5
3 1
1 1
7 7
");
std::ostringstream out;
std::streambuf* cout_old = std::cout.rdbuf(out.rdbuf());
solve(in, out);
std::cout.rdbuf(cout_old);
CHECK_EQ(out.str(), std::string("OUT
IN
IN
OUT
"));
tests.hint: The notch at (3,3) makes (3,5) outside; integer crossing test handles it.

tests.name: load: 200000 queries on the same polygon
tests.hint: O(n) per query is fine here; the point is exact integer answers at load.
